name: omal-erp
description: OMAL ERP - inventory and business management for Accra Showroom & Tema Depot

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @omal/api" "npm run dev -w @omal/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @omal/api && npm run build -w @omal/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @omal/api && npm run test -w @omal/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @omal/api && npm run typecheck -w @omal/web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
